note: Texas Senate general election results by district and county, 2008-2018, read in a browser from the Texas Secretary of State Election History pages (official canvassed results). Checks run during extraction: every county row adds up to its total; the counties add up to the page's ALL COUNTIES row; every candidate's total matches the Statewide Race Summary page. Every district in that year's Democratic or Republican primary was on the November ballot (no unopposed districts were left off).
